register.labelZh: GO DOWN 片語動詞的實際用途
register.labelEn: GO DOWN Phrasal Verbs in Use
register.summaryZh: GO DOWN 表達可以描述南下另一個城市,也可以描述由較高位置前往較低位置。；你可以使用 go down 描述升降機、道路、樓梯、山坡、滑梯及其他向下移動的情況。；go down with something 是英式英語中表示患病的常見說法。；go down as something 可以描述一場比賽、演說、決定或事件日後會如何被銘記。
register.summaryEn: GO DOWN expressions can describe travelling south to another city or moving from a high place to a lower one. You can use go down for lifts, roads, stairs, hills, slides and other downward movement. Go down with something is a common British English expression for becoming ill. Go down as something helps you describe how a match, speech, decision or event will be remembered.
